subject: Pricing follow-up: token benchmarking & target $/1M — Redwood vs OpenAI/Anthropic
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Smith <alice@acme.com>, David Park <david@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + follow-up: token volumes & target $/1M (Redwood vs OpenAI/Anthropic)

Hi Alice / David — great talking earlier today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can put together a concrete pricing/comparison proposal: 

Call recap (high level)
- Use case: customer-support augmentation + semantic search across product docs (latency < 150ms target for chat).
- Current provider: you mentioned experimenting with OpenAI for some workloads and hosting open models for lower-cost batch jobs.
- Traffic profile: you estimated a baseline of ~80M tokens/mo, with burst / growth to ~250M tokens/mo within 6–9 months.

Open asks for our pricing comparison
1) Can you confirm the monthly token range to use for the proposal (baseline / peak)?
2) What is your target $/1M tokens to be competitive internally? If you have a target band (e.g., $5–$10 / 1M for open-model hosting vs $15–$25 / 1M for hosted API) that helps.
3) Any hard constraints (SLA, private deployment, required certifications)?

What we'll deliver next
- A short benchmarking sheet comparing Redwood hosted, Redwood dedicated (committed), and typical OpenAI / Anthropic / hosted open-model host economics by $/1M tokens given your volumes.
- Suggested commitment tiers and expected unit price with/without prefix caching and batching benefits applied.
- A proposed PoC plan (2-week trial + sample eval prompts).

I've attached a draft pricing sheet and the token-estimates workbook. If you can reply with the confirmed token numbers and the internal target $/1M band, we'll finalize the recommendation and give you modeled monthly spend and headroom for growth.

Thanks,

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0143

--
Attachment: 20270410-redwood-pricing-sheet.pdf (pricing sheet, 2 pages)
Attachment: acme-token-estimates.xlsx (workbook with monthly scenarios)

From: Alice Smith <alice@acme.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Park <david@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + follow-up: token volumes & target $/1M (Redwood vs OpenAI/Anthropic)

Thanks Vanessa — thanks for the clear notes. Confirming numbers from our side: 
- Baseline: ~80M tokens/month (mostly customer support chat; avg ~900 tokens/session)
- Expected growth / peak (6 months): ~250M tokens/month (scale from pilot + automation of escalation flows)

Target economics: our finance lead asked us to aim for ~$10 / 1M tokens for high-volume async workloads (open-model hosting), and up to ~$20–$25 / 1M for low-latency hosted API (chat).

Current stack + benchmarked pricing:
- OpenAI: we see effective ~$22–$28 / 1M for the chat workflows we're running today (gives us the latency we need).
- Anthropic: similar ballpark for chat (~$20–$26 / 1M) — slightly better on some prompts but throughput limits were an issue.
- Self-hosted / other hosts: we've seen $6–$12 / 1M depending on model and infra setup — but ops overhead and reliability vary.

Constraints:
- Must support SOC 2 and enterprise audit logs (non-negotiable).
- Will consider private deployment if pricing/SLAs required.

Next: can you model a committed discounted price for 12-month reserved capacity (we're open to a commit if unit economics hit our target)? Also forward the pricing sheet to finance (ccing me is fine).

Best,
Alice
Director of Product Operations | Acme Corp
alice@acme.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Smith <alice@acme.com>, David Park <david@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + follow-up: token volumes & target $/1M (Redwood vs OpenAI/Anthropic)

Alice — great, thanks for the detail and the target bands. Based on your baseline/peak and the $/1M targets, here's a short benchmark and suggested next steps (attached summary + numbers inline):

Quick benchmark (modeled on your 250M peak) — rough unit $/1M tokens
- OpenAI (chat-optimized): $22–$28 / 1M (observed)
- Anthropic (chat-optimized): $20–$26 / 1M (observed)
- Typical open-model hosts (no commit): $6–$12 / 1M (depends on model, region, infra)

Redwood proposals (examples)
- Redwood Hosted (on-demand): $18 / 1M — full managed hosted API with SLAs, streaming, function calling. Matches latency targets, good for early production chat.
- Redwood Dedicated (12-month commit): $6 / 1M — dedicated GPU pool, predictable throughput; this assumes a 12-month commit sized to ~250M tokens/mo equivalent (we’ll map tokens->GPU-hours to size). Includes enterprise audit logs and SOC 2 controls.
- Redwood Private (VPC / on-prem): pricing varies but typical target $5–$9 / 1M at scale (ops-managed by customer), good fit if you want full isolation.

Notes on how we get to lower unit $/1M
- Batching & KV/prefix caching: reduces billed tokens by eliminating repeated prompt context for common flows (we typically see 10–25% effective token reduction for support workflows).
- Model selection / quantization: open-model hosting with 8-bit paths yields big infra savings vs float32 hosting.
- Smart routing: route latency-sensitive chat to hosted slots and bulk async to dedicated low-cost pools.

Suggested next steps
1) I'll send an updated pricing sheet with modeled monthly spend for baseline and peak, showing the Dedicated (commit) math vs Hosted.
2) If that hits your target, we can outline a 12-month reserved capacity contract (we have standard commit tiers + overage rules).
3) PoC: 2-week pilot on a segment of your support traffic (we'll instrument cost-per-conversation and latency).

Marissa — looping you in for pricing/discount approval. For Acme’s numbers a 12-month commit to reach ~$6 / 1M is within the ranges we can support with a finance-approved discount. I can put together a draft term sheet if you authorize me to proceed.

Alice / David — any immediate questions on the assumptions? If you want I can also show a side-by-side month-by-month spend table for the next 12 months.

Thanks,
Vanessa

--
Attachment: 20270412-redwood-pricing-modeled.xlsx (detailed model)
